transcript.text: bosch washer FD 9409 not draining. ive cleaned the filter already. what part do i need?

With the filter cleaned, the two main possibilities are a blocked/kinked drain hose or waste connection, and a jammed or failed drain pump. Both can give exactly the same “not draining” symptom. 1. Switch off and unplug the washer. Check the drain hose along the back for crushing or kinks, then check where it enters the standpipe or sink waste for an obvious blockage. Towels handy in case water escapes.
2. Then run a drain or spin programme and listen at the lower front: is there a hum/whirring from the pump, or is it completely silent? A humming pump with no water leaving points first to a restriction in the hose/waste connection or something still trapped around the pump. A silent pump, once the hose and waste route are clear, makes the drain pump the likely failed part. If the external route is clear but it hums and still cannot shift water, an internal sump-hose blockage or jammed pump is more likely and is usually an engineer job.
hose behind looks ok and the sink drains fine. pump hums but no water moves, with a bit of a rattle. so is it the pump I need?

[Heading: Likely cause: drain pump]
Most likely, yes: the drain pump is the part implicated. I would not call it certain until an engineer has ruled out an obstruction in the internal sump hose (between drum and pump), as that can produce the same result and is not normally an owner-safe strip-down job. If the pump is replaced while that hose is blocked, the new pump will still not drain. FD 9409 is a Bosch production/date identifier rather than a full appliance model reference, so it is not enough to select a compatible pump. Use the complete E-number from the rating plate—usually around the door opening or on the rear—with Bosch spares, or give it to an appliance engineer. Ask them to check the sump hose and pump impeller first, then replace the drain pump if the water path is clear. Given the rattle and no discharge, a pump replacement is a reasonable expectation, but have the internal blockage ruled out at the same visit.

candidates: Drain hose or household waste connection blocked or kinked (medium)
Drain pump obstructed, jammed or failed (medium)
